facts.value: The source declares a static mnSnap_State singleton, with field annotations spanning offsets 0x000 through 0x17C, and a separate four-element array of struct mnSnap_804A0B90_t pointers. The singleton retains GObj, JObj, asset and text pointers plus menu, card, page, dialog, timer and thumbnail-loading fields. These declarations describe runtime objects; their compiled adjacency and complete section layout are not established here.
facts.rationale: Corrects the obsolete void-pointer declaration and separates source annotations from compiled layout claims.

evidence.why: Current singleton and typed pointer-array declarations.

facts.value: Stores menu input obtained with selector 4—the selector used by Menu_GetAllInputs—in shared menu-input state, then consumes the singleton's card statuses/counts, active slot, state, cursors, timers, dialog results and presentation pointers. Card operations and input update thumbnail pages, selection/move transforms, full-view image descriptors, visibility, animations, dialog text and progress position. The normal tail repeatedly services pending thumbnail loads until none remain; the early active-card recovery path clears the queue and returns before that tail.
facts.rationale: Preserves the controller's data flow while removing a physical port-4 implication and qualifying the terminal-drain claim.

evidence.why: Presentation, operations and terminal loader loop.

facts.value: Reads global menu cooldown first; a nonzero cooldown decrements the animation timer and returns without reading input or incrementing frame_count. Otherwise it reads aggregate menu input and album state. Back in state 2 or 4 clears entering_menu, requests transition (5, 0, 3), removes the four retained presentation GObjs when present, and removes four thumbnail labels, two count texts, page_text, total_text and dlg_text when present. It returns after teardown; every other post-cooldown path increments frame_count once. The external thumbnail image buffers are not freed here.
facts.rationale: Corrects the missing cooldown exception while preserving the exact teardown inventory and buffer-lifetime distinction.

facts.value: For a valid cursor and positive count, actions are mutually exclusive in Up, Down, Left, Right, L-trigger, R-trigger priority. Up subtracts one from an odd index; Down adds one to an even index if the next item exists. Left subtracts two when the index is at least two; Right adds two when the next pair exists, correcting an exact count overrun by subtracting one. Left/Right can cross four-item page boundaries. L/R move by four with first/last-page wrapping, preserving page-relative position when valid and otherwise selecting the destination page's first entry. The final cursor is always written back; unchanged movement emits no sound and returns 0, while changed movement emits sound and returns 1 for the same page or 2 for a different page.
facts.rationale: Canonical input definitions reverse the baseline's axis interpretation. Arithmetic also permits directional cross-page movement rather than restricting it to triggers.
Describes the two-indicator refresh while avoiding the existing canonical mnSnap_AnimateCardSlots inline. This is a semantic name, not a recovered original symbol.

facts.value: Refreshes both memory-card slot highlight hierarchies from retained status and selection: status zero requests frame 2; any nonzero status, including negative error statuses, requests frame 1 for the active slot or frame 0 for the inactive slot. Each hierarchy is immediately evaluated. This is selector presentation, not a test that the card is usable for browsing.
facts.rationale: Makes the exact predicate explicit and prevents available/selected presentation from being mistaken for card health.

evidence.why: Negative status mapping and nonzero highlight branch.

facts.value: Resolves named resources from the loaded menu archive into singleton fields and constructs retained main, slot-selector, cursor-owned and warning hierarchies. Four thumbnail JObjs are extracted from the main hierarchy. The helper named mnSnap_CreateThumbnails instead constructs five option_jobjs from MenMainSubCsrSn resources, placing option i at start + i * (end - start). The MenMainPhotoSn resource stored in page_joint becomes fullview_jobj under the cursor-owned hierarchy. The constructor retains the blank image pointer, creates four thumbnail labels, two card counts and current/total page texts, extracts dialog widgets, and publishes the presentation to the registered primary and exit processes.
facts.rationale: Corrects the five-thumbnail and page-indicator interpretations by following actual output fields and consumers rather than misleading helper names/comments.

evidence.why: Resource routing, extraction, text creation and process registration.

facts.value: Enters menu kind 0x19 with global cooldown 5, clears the album singleton, and initializes state 0, timer 6, zero counts/statuses for both card slots and no active dialog. The page arrow starts hidden because the initial count is zero; the move marker and full-view photograph object also start hidden. The constructor registers the primary state-machine process and a secondary exit process. The latter suppresses both input and frame-count advancement during cooldown, accepts Back only in states 2 or 4, and increments frame_count only on post-cooldown paths that do not exit.
facts.rationale: Replaces the erroneous page-indicator identity and preserves the secondary handler's cooldown exception.
